lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. The spots exhibit a structured grid-like spacing with larger diameters than those on the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the larger flank spots, creating a vertical-linear organizational structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible running through the upper third of the flank, characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a dark shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Transition from high-density, small-diameter punctate spots on the rostrum/cranial region to larger, more widely spaced spots on the lateral flank.
